about: A free online editor for GPS tracks, for planning, editing and merging routes.

prs.title: Temperatures from Garmin files are kept
prs.broken: Temperatures in tracks exported from Garmin Connect were dropped on import, because Garmin writes them with a decimal point.
prs.changed: Decimal temperatures are now read and rounded, so they stay in the file.
prs.matters: Riders and runners keep their temperature data after editing a track.

prs.title: Waypoint times survive opening and saving a file
prs.broken: Opening a file with timestamped waypoints and saving it again removed every waypoint's time.
prs.changed: Waypoint times are now read on import, just like track point times.
prs.matters: Editing a route no longer quietly loses when each stop was recorded.
